payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_cli.py::test_saffron_draft_mints_nothing_without_readiness_or_a_single_id_prefix stayed green with the spec's wrong version "A raise from the seed helper falls back to the first spec file's id." applied to saffron/cli.py as an edit. The claim was "`saffron draft` exits 2 with no run, no task and no adapter built when readiness fails, when the working tree's specs hold no id prefix or more than one, and when the item is not UTF-8. A failed readiness prints its step and detail. The witness drives all four.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
